blocks.prompt: 2. Find the moment of inertia of a uniform triangular lamina about its base.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi continuous body ki moment of inertia ka sawal hai, is liye strip method lagega, aur strips axis (yani base) ke parallel lenge.
Diya kya hai? Ek uniform triangle; kitab ne naap nahin diye, is liye hum base ko \(a\), height ko \(h\) aur mass ko \(M\) kehte hain.
Find kya karna hai? Base ke gird \(I\).
Plan: base se \(y\) unchai par strip lein, us ki lambai similar triangles se nikaalein, density se \(\delta m\) banayein, phir \(I = \int_0^h y^{2}\,dm\).
steps:
Diya gaya: uniform triangular lamina \(ABC\), base \(BC = a\), height \(h\) (\(A\) se \(BC\) tak), mass \(M\).
Maloom karna: base \(BC\) ke gird \(I\).
Tareeqa: triangle ko \(BC\) ke parallel patli strips mein kaatein. Strip ka har point \(BC\) se ek hi faasle \(y\) par hai, is liye us ki moment of inertia \(y^{2}\,\delta m\) hai.

Density
\[\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2}ah, \qquad \rho = \dfrac{M}{\frac{1}{2}ah} = \dfrac{2M}{ah}\]
Kyun: lamina uniform hai, is liye fi unit area mass = kul mass \(\div\) kul area. Triangle ka area \(\frac{1}{2} \times\) base \(\times\) height.

\(y\) unchai par strip ki lambai
Base se \(y\) faasle par strip \(PQ\) ek chhota triangle \(APQ\) kaat deti hai jis ki height \(h - y\) hai, aur yeh \(ABC\) ke similar (hum shakal) hai.
\[\dfrac{PQ}{BC} = \dfrac{h - y}{h} \Rightarrow PQ = \dfrac{a(h - y)}{h}\]
Kyun: similar triangles mein matching lambaiyan heights ki nisbat (ratio) mein hoti hain. Upar jate jao to strip chhoti hoti jati hai: \(y = 0\) par \(PQ = a\) (poora base), \(y = h\) par \(PQ = 0\) (choti).
Dhyan dein: \(PQ = \frac{ay}{h}\) likh dena aam ghalti hai; woh lambai vertex se naapne par aati hai, base se nahin.

Strip ka mass (motai \(\delta y\))
\[\delta m = \dfrac{2M}{ah}\cdot\dfrac{a(h - y)}{h}\,\delta y\]
\[= \dfrac{2M}{h^{2}}(h - y)\,\delta y\]
Kyun: mass = density \(\times\) area, aur strip ka area \(PQ \times \delta y\) hai. \(a\) cancel ho gaya.

Saari strips jama karein
\[I = \int_{0}^{h} y^{2}\cdot\dfrac{2M}{h^{2}}(h - y)\,dy\]
\[= \dfrac{2M}{h^{2}}\int_{0}^{h}(hy^{2} - y^{3})\,dy\]
Kyun: strips base (\(y = 0\)) se vertex \(A\) (\(y = h\)) tak hain. Bracket khol kar \(y^{2}(h - y) = hy^{2} - y^{3}\) likha taa ke power rule seedha lag sake.

Tasdeeq
Unit mass \(\times\) lambai\(^2\) hai \(\checkmark\). Base ki lambai \(a\) jawab se ghayab ho gayi, jo samajh mein aata hai: triangle ko base ki seedh mein chaura karne se koi mass base se door nahin jata. Radius of gyration \(R = \frac{h}{\sqrt{6}}\).
Muqabla kijiye: rectangle (unchai \(h\)) apni ek side ke gird \(\frac{1}{3}Mh^{2}\) deta hai. Triangle ka zyada mass base ke qareeb hai (upar ja kar woh patla hota jata hai), is liye us ki \(I\) kam, yani \(\frac{1}{6}Mh^{2}\), hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(I = \dfrac{1}{6}Mh^{2}\), jahan \(M\) mass aur \(h\) base se naapi gayi triangle ki height hai.
